# Provenance and licences

The product is GPL-3.0-or-later. Original game data is neither relicensed nor included in packages.

* `src/saga2/`: SAGA2 from ScummVM revision `1a3e816afd5ddc41cc2a5c51a5da292e6d61758c`, GPL-3.0-or-later. Copyright notices remain in every imported file; see `SCUMMVM-COPYRIGHT` and the root `LICENSE`. [Source](https://github.com/scummvm/scummvm/tree/1a3e816afd5ddc41cc2a5c51a5da292e6d61758c/engines/saga2).
* `src/audio/midiparser.{h,cpp}`, `midiparser_xmidi.cpp`, `miles_adlib.cpp`: selected portable MIDI algorithms from that same ScummVM revision, GPL-3.0-or-later. `midi.h` provides a new one-source native interface, with MIDI constants from upstream `audio/mididrv.h` and Miles constants from `audio/miles.h`.
* `src/audio/nuked.{h,cpp}`, `nuked_wf_rom.h`: Nuked-OPL3-fast 1.8-fast.2 as distributed in that revision, LGPL-2.1-or-later, Nuke.YKT and Tony Gies. See `NUKED-LGPL-2.1`; original notices are retained. Only the chip algorithms remain; the ScummVM audio-chip adapter was removed.
* SDL 3.4.18: zlib licence, `SDL-LICENSE.txt`. Fetched as a checksum-pinned release archive, or provided by the builder. Bundled as a shared runtime library.
* `assets/fta2.png` and `assets/fta2.ico`: the ScummVM community game icon and its converted Windows sizes. See `APP-ICON.md` for pinned source, contributors, checksums and the supplied upstream GPL version 2 text. The icon is bundled explicitly; it is not verified as the original Windows release icon.
* The Windows cross-build uses Zig 0.16.0 and its statically linked C++/compiler runtimes. Notices for libc++, libc++abi and libunwind (Apache-2.0 with LLVM exceptions), MinGW-w64 (its supplied COPYING notice), and Zig compiler runtime code (MIT) are preserved in `windows-runtime/`. These build-runtime components are separate from the imported SAGA2 code.

## Changes to imported code

The Community Edition branding update in 0.1.48 adds an original palette-drawn information control to `playmode.cpp`, reserves its status-line space in `intrface.cpp` and reuses the existing decorated-dialog resources in `uidialog.cpp`. The modal displays shared build metadata and localized captions. No new artwork, upstream source, simulation algorithm or save format is imported.

Version 0.1.47 applies presentation preferences after input dispatch while Options remains open. The existing framebuffer transition recenters Options and preserves controls/inventory windows; stale saved backgrounds are discarded. Night previews the original palette immediately without ambient-music selection. Other modal documents retain their previous presentation guard. No gameplay algorithm, original data or save format changes are introduced. Runtime packages retain compact licence/attribution notices; full provenance and development documentation remain in the embedded corresponding source ZIP.

The Czech localization work adds presentation-only name/script lookups, an independent Language modal, memory copies of original bitmap fonts with Czech diacritics, explicit counted-item forms and a captured speech display buffer. Original interpreter strings, resource/voice identifiers and `SPCH` serialization remain canonical. Optional `NLOC` metadata preserves localized pending speech without changing the global user language. Signed glyph-byte indexing is corrected for Windows-1250; loaded speech initializes its selected-button state, bounds its line/choice arrays and releases cached speech images on cleanup. Documents and fixed controls diagnose overflow without shrinking fonts. Original data and imported copyright notices remain unchanged. Draft translation model attribution, pinned package hash and remaining review status are documented in [`localization/README.md`](../localization/README.md#draft-translation-provenance); the model and translator are not bundled dependencies.

Version 0.1.43 replaces the Czech portrait-label UI font with in-memory composition from the user's original BTN 8/9 engraved lettering, retaining the original palette and textured plate edges. Only coordinates and accent/F composition rules are source code; original pixels remain runtime input. The Language modal is compacted and its draft notice removed at the user's request. Credits roles/headings are translated while original author spelling and licensing notices remain. Common NAME labels use Czech lowercase conventions, with proper-name exceptions recorded in the review journal. See [`research/czech-display-0.1.43-validation.json`](../research/czech-display-0.1.43-validation.json).

Version 0.1.44 corrects the coordinate space of the imported document renderer's background clip. Scrolls and parchment now erase previous page text when centered in widescreen. Original artwork, fonts, paging and resource data are retained; regression checks compare incremental navigation with full repaints. See [`research/document-redraw-0.1.44-validation.json`](../research/document-redraw-0.1.44-validation.json).

Version 0.1.45 routes the imported mana indicator callback through its existing localized label definitions before formatting current/base values. Original mana calculations and catalog content are unchanged. See [`research/mana-tooltip-0.1.45-validation.json`](../research/mana-tooltip-0.1.45-validation.json).

Version 0.1.23 sends pointer leave through the original panel handler before a window discards mouse and focus references. The handler clears inventory hover text and its delayed cache, preventing tooltips from returning after Escape closure. Active controls are deactivated once; the existing drag-close guard remains ahead of cleanup. Simulation, object actions and save formats are unchanged.

Version 0.1.22 joins the optional gold medallion and original weight/volume indicators into one continuous decorative strip. It reuses the 45-pixel medallion pitch and internal joint from CONT/GJB0, replacing the ready-panel outer left border with the matching inner artwork. Container-window frames, pie artwork and hit regions remain unchanged. No assets, dependencies or simulation algorithms were imported or changed.

Version 0.1.21 anchors the default mental inventory window to the active sidebar at opening. Both known default rectangles are recognized, including those restored from saves; other remembered coordinates are preserved. The original 4:3 rectangle, artwork, controls, simulation and save format remain unchanged.

Version 0.1.20 preserves the full original circular CONT/GJB0 bezel and gold corners for the coin medallion, replacing only its symbol-bearing interior with bronze palette shades. The original coin sprite and light gold fitted number sit inside the circular inset. Hover handling reuses original cursor text and panel polling for an exact, live Gold tooltip; the field has no click action and is inactive outside individual New layout. Resources, simulation and save formats remain unchanged.

Version 0.1.19 aligns the optional sidebar's six controls to a 28 × 27 grid with five-pixel gaps. HP composites and scales its original star/frame artwork into one control; disabling the option restores the original sizes and positions. The individual coin counter reuses the four-pixel decoration and warm background from the left half of CONT/GJB0, removing its embedded balance symbol and fitting the original coin sprite and exact total within the border. Original resources, counting rules and save formats remain unchanged.

Optional widescreen rendering adds a native display layout to the imported SAGA2 renderer and UI: a 654 × 420 map inside an 854 × 480 framebuffer, with the original sidebar translated by 214 pixels. The original 640 × 480 mode and 100-object rendering limit remain the defaults; wide mode allows 150 display objects without changing simulation activation distances. Options adds a persisted checkbox and defers buffer replacement until modal input and saved-background restoration finish. Modal centering, window clipping, camera offsets, speech placement and input bounds follow the active layout. Original decorative resources are reused without modifying game data, and gameplay save chunks remain unchanged.

Framework includes and `Common::` utility types were replaced by `platform/runtime.h` and `Native::` types backed by the C++ standard library. The native engine has no ScummVM `Engine`, `OSystem`, plugin registration, launcher, GUI debugger, configuration, stream, save manager or event infrastructure. Detection/metaengine/console implementation files are excluded from this product entirely. Gameplay, SAGA bytecode interpretation and software rendering remain in SAGA2.

DOS executable resources use the independently recovered DOS addresses and checked F2R1 pack. The fake DOS voice archive is ignored, unvoiced dialogue retains readable text, and missing movies finish immediately. Version 0.1.32 additionally accepts a separately verified original CD voice supplement. Save files retain the original chunks, adding optional native RNG state. Reverse list traversal uses standard reverse iterators; closing the last window handles an empty list. The XMIDI/Miles algorithms use the native mixer and Nuked chip; MIDI timer callbacks are driven by generated audio samples. See `docs/architecture.md` and `docs/validation.md` for scope and verified limits.

`upstream-files.json` records SHA-256 hashes of the pristine imported source files, before these changes, to make the source revision and subsequent modifications auditable. The separate reference patches apply to the unmodified ScummVM revision; they are not linked into the product.

Native ownership fixes release retired motion tasks after the game step, detach cancelled path requests, and free player wrappers, association streams, effect prototype arrays, old band lists and the framebuffer. Motion tasks are value-initialized so save files do not contain uninitialized fields. These changes were checked against the reference world chunks and with AddressSanitizer/LeakSanitizer.

Version 0.1.6 extends the imported Options dialog with Hot Keys, reusing its original button images, decorative panels and fonts. The native shortcut overview has independent modal state and does not change gameplay bindings. The previously empty M handler now persists a music mute setting; the native music renderer applies it under its existing mutex while continuing sample-driven synthesis and XMIDI timing.

Version 0.1.7 reads both reserved IMPO import fields instead of discarding them; the first identifies the original credits script (110 in the supported DOS profile). The document renderer no longer prepends the obsolete imported W95 build stamp. Nested modal windows restore their parent modal pointer. Options uses visible ghosted artwork for mandatory speech text and an informational empty-save message without a restart action. Save discovery validates original save chunks, and header names are bounded before use.

Version 0.1.8 restores the imported Speech Text toggle and loads the persisted subtitles preference instead of forcing it on. Missing, empty or muted voice requests return failure before queueing, allowing the original text/timing fallback to operate. Saved speech voice flags are cleared before layout when voice playback is disabled. Completed speech tasks release their allocation after unlinking; the new dialogue scenario exposed the upstream disposal leak under LeakSanitizer. The supported data profile remains unchanged.

Document page-break removal copies the terminating null byte with the remaining text, preventing stale characters from appearing after the final credits paragraph. Original script text and page breaks are preserved.

Version 0.1.9 centralizes document cursor selection across opening, movement, dragging and release, excluding the close control. Document close and destruction restore the original normal pointer and hotspot. The native cursor adapter uploads pixels on every image update: address and size equality cannot establish unchanged content when composed cursor bitmaps are rebuilt. Existing book pagination and vertical document navigation are preserved.

Version 0.1.10 carries SDL wheel position and normalized vertical deltas through the internal native event path. The UI dispatcher delivers wheel events only to the top modal document without changing button or focus state. Vertical documents accumulate fractional movement privately and use the existing page-up/page-down handlers; their close controls and horizontal books remain outside wheel navigation. No game data or page artwork is changed.

Version 0.1.11 gives Escape priority to the frontmost open container during gameplay. It reuses the existing close-button callback, including original object scripts, open flags and deferred window cleanup. Modal dialogs retain their own Escape handling; O continues to open Options. The Hot Keys description now reflects container closure. No public API, option or game-data change is introduced.

Version 0.1.12 adds G/Shift+G to the imported gameplay key handler and a fourteenth row to Hot Keys, using 13-pixel row spacing within the existing 487 × 320 dialog. It searches the selected brother's carried objects with `RecursiveContainerIterator` and reuses `MotionTask::useObject`; Ctrl/Alt, UI locks, modal input, choice dialogue and object manipulation block it. Map identification comes from the immutable supported DOS `FTA.HRS` (SHA-256 `1d4fc56861bdc3f0e1dda1a21f48991e350dd8213fb694484f0f7fa731c7055d`), resource `LIST/PRO\0` at byte 17890, 52-byte record 320 at byte 34530: class 13 (Inventory), script 1149, name index 617. Original `LIST/OBJE` map objects 408, 3314 and 3315 are in Sacks 3887, 3888 and 3889. The unused `AutoMapProto` class and displayed names are not used for detection. No original data, public API, preference or CLI option changes.

Version 0.1.14 aligns the Widescreen checkbox with Night and Auto-Wield Weapon, reuses the original 18 × 17 checkbox bounds for hit testing and full redraw, and restores the 263-pixel Options height. It retains the original checkbox artwork and setting behavior.

Version 0.1.15 updates native SDL window sizing and development probes. The original per-world exploration algorithm, radius, corner exclusion and save format remain unchanged.

Version 0.1.16 removes duplicate control rectangles from the imported compressed-button classes and their constructor initialization. Hit testing, rendering and state-change invalidation now share the inherited panel bounds after widescreen translation. The original artwork and gameplay selection rules are preserved.

Version 0.1.17 adds an optional individual sidebar layout with compact nearest-neighbour mental controls beside HP and a carried Gold Coin total in their old position. The existing Options completion path applies the preference; ready-container construction now respects the active sidebar offset after loading. Currency identification comes from the supported immutable DOS `FTA.HRS` (SHA-256 `1d4fc56861bdc3f0e1dda1a21f48991e350dd8213fb694484f0f7fa731c7055d`), resource `LIST/PRO\0` at byte 17890, 52-byte record 354 at byte 36298: class 13 (Inventory), name index 437 (Gold Coin), flags `0x1001` including mergeability. Summing `getExtra()` through `RecursiveContainerIterator` follows the existing script payment-count semantics. The original data, artwork sources, currency mechanics and save format remain unchanged.

Version 0.1.18 extends the optional sidebar layout to all three group-view brothers, using the original mental-control artwork and per-brother selection/container actions. It replaces the individual gold label with the original Gold Coin inventory sprite and prototype palette translation, fitted with nearest-neighbour scaling. The currency emblem uses `iconSprite` 43 plus the original mergeable stack offset 3 (sprite 46, a pile of 25+ coins), including at a zero balance. Health frames and hit regions follow the optional positions in both panels. No additional upstream code, assets or dependencies were imported.

Version 0.1.32 adapts the already imported SAGA2 Shorten decoder to bounded native reads and RAII predictor/output buffers, preserving the original raw voice format. All 4,320 verified English CD recordings match the pinned imported decoder's PCM output. The voice queue owns decoded streams before accepting dialogue, clears pending segments on abort and retains text fallback for unavailable or silent speech. HRES internal offsets preserve all 31 non-external bits, including the last CD recording beyond 256 MiB. Stereo PCM retains channel separation and frame duration in the native mixer. No additional upstream source or game artwork is imported into the source distribution. The optional original voice data retains its own copyright and is provided only as a separate local user-requested supplement.


Version 0.1.34 makes the native deferred-retirement adaptation of SAGA2 motion tasks idempotent. Original `Actor::die()` callbacks can retire a task before the animation dispatcher completes; repeated retirement previously scheduled the same pointer for deletion twice. Only the repeated removal is skipped. Persistent native diagnostics record actor death, input, save/load and voice requests without changing original data or serialized game chunks. No new upstream code is imported.

Version 0.1.48 extends the presentation service to Spanish/French, with separate Windows-1252 font recipes (including cedillas, tildes, inverted punctuation and ligatures), per-language catalogs/plurals and stable NLOC language values. Canonical script data and original English save chunks remain unchanged. Local draft generation provenance and model attribution are recorded in [the localization notes](../localization/README.md#spanish-and-french-drafts-in-0148); no model or original text corpus is distributed.

Community Edition 0.0.1 includes one explicitly requested gameplay preview in `assets/gameplay.png` for the README. It is an unscaled 854 × 480 engine capture showing original game artwork; that artwork retains its original copyright and is not covered by the engine GPL. The preview is included in corresponding sources, not installed as a loose runtime asset. All other extracted screenshots/resources remain private development output. No new upstream code or dependency is imported by the version reset and release automation.

Community Edition 0.0.1 adds arrow-key viewport scrolling to the imported AutoMap UI, preserving its original diagonal keys and draw-time map bounds. The UI dispatcher no longer applies character case conversion to special key codes. MSVC engine compilation enables `/bigobj` for the generated localization catalog. No additional upstream code, dependencies or original artwork is imported.
